response: ["When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.", "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.", "The consensus rate for the assessment was 100% (21/21).", "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.", "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.", "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible.", "The criteria driving the 4‑point score are streaks (irregular, 1 point), pigmentation (diffuse irregular, 1 point), dots_and_globules (irregular, 1 point), and regression_structures (blue areas, 1 point).", "The major criteria (pigment_network, blue_whitish_veil, vascular_structures) were all scored as absent or typical, contributing 0 points.", "You should look for irregular radial lines or pseudopods (streaks) on the image.", "You should look for asymmetric blotches of pigment (pigmentation) on the image.", "You should look for varied‑size dots or globules (dots_and_globules) on the image.", "You should look for blue peppering or scar‑like areas (regression_structures) on the image."]
